name: Bokudo Aoi
source:
A girl with a timid personality.
After being startled by a pervert on the train, she let out a fart so stinky that she got mistaken for a terrorist. She joined Asterisk to repay her debt to Yuri, who saved her from that predicament.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01039895.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
